draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.50, the 261st-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 20th of 20 at S. He went 253rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 47 tackles in 2021, 16th of 19 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals (practice squad). 36 career games and 10 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2024 against a career-best 3 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (1st percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-3 safety who played: 1.8% season snap share against a median of 51.8%, below the norm.
